questions.prompt: Which explorer is credited with first sighting the Pacific from the Americas?
questions.fact: He crossed Panama on foot in 1513, and was executed six years later by a rival who had him charged with treason.

questions.prompt: Which human sense is most closely linked to memory and emotion?
questions.fact: Its signals reach the emotional centres of the brain almost directly, bypassing the relay every other sense goes through.

questions.prompt: What does a yellow card signify in football?
questions.fact: The idea came from traffic lights, after a referee struggled to make himself understood across a language barrier.

questions.prompt: Which director is known for the films Vertigo and Rear Window?
questions.fact: He appeared briefly in most of his own films, and moved the cameos early so audiences would stop hunting for him mid-plot.

questions.prompt: Which is the world's longest mountain range, including underwater sections?
questions.fact: It runs some 16,000 kilometres along the ocean floor, and Iceland is one of the few places it breaks the surface.

questions.prompt: Which novel is set at Manderley?
questions.fact: Its opening line about dreaming of Manderley is regularly voted among the best in English fiction.

questions.prompt: What does a router do on a network?
questions.fact: Every packet you send crosses a dozen or more of them, each deciding independently where to pass it next.
